description: Every inline element and style property this crate reads, in one paragraph
notes: Decodes to 'plain bold italic under struck span'. The span carries colour #FF0000, background #FFFF00, 14pt and font family 'Courier New' - the family is written with " entities, which is what a serializer emits inside an already-double-quoted attribute and what a CSS splitter that treats the entity's ';' as a declaration separator gets wrong.
